title: Peel the protective film off a steel plate while holding the plate down
instruction: Peel the blue protective film from its raised tab while holding the loose steel plate in place. Lay the detached film on the table outside the plate and withdraw both hands.
context: After fabrication, workers remove temporary protective film to expose the finished sheet-metal surface. This task tests complete adhesive-layer removal while keeping an unsecured workpiece in place, then clearing the intact detached film.
setup: A loose brushed 304 stainless steel plate, 350 x 100 x 1 mm and 280 g, lies flat on the oak tabletop (1.10 x 1.30 x 0.06 m). World x points forward, y left and z up; table centre is (0.36,0,0.7175) m, top at z=0.7475 m. The calibrated dual-YAM station has arm bases at (0,+/-0.305,0.75) m, left at +y, both facing +x. Plate centre is (0.28,-0.01,0.7480) m with its long side along y. An 80 mm wide, nominally 0.05 mm blue PE protective film covers x=0.24..0.32 m and y=-0.185..-0.055 m (130 mm bonded length). Its 20 mm nonadhesive tab extends from the crease at y=-0.055 m, raised 70 degrees above the plate and leaning toward the bonded film. The remaining 220 mm of plate toward +y is bare. No other loose objects are present.
scoring: At every control step, the plate must remain within 30 mm horizontally and 5 mm vertically of its start, and within 10 degrees of initial yaw and tilt; any violation or breaking the film into separate pieces makes the trial score zero. Credit for consecutive peeled length: <30 mm: 0; >=30 mm: 0.25; >=70 mm: 0.5; >=110 mm: 0.75. Full credit: all 130 mm detached, the film supported by the table, all pieces within 30 mm above the tabletop and entirely at least 2 mm outside the plate, both TCPs at least 80 mm from the film and plate, all film pieces moving below 10 mm/s and 0.5 rad/s for 1 s.
reset_notes: Use a new film for each physical trial. Press the bonded portion flat from the tab crease at y=-0.055 m toward y=-0.185 m, and raise the tab as in the setup. Simulator reset restores the same geometry and all adhesive joints.
fidelity: Isaac Lab-Arena/PhysX. Film is a tab and thirteen 10 mm rigid strips, 1 mm thick, total mass 11.1 g; it cannot stretch, wrinkle or tear. Adhesion uses 0.03 N m/rad angular springs; only the peel-front bond releases after 60 degrees of upward opening, checked at 20 Hz. Hinges have weak viscous damping. The tab crease has a 0.0002 N m torque limit. This is an approximate cohesive model, not measured PE adhesion. The loose plate has friction 0.4.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (2,400 steps); scripted demo: 1.0 (704 steps).
